slice: Integrations calendar sync (spec 29 item 9, scheduling): a server-side MyTribe Cloud Function reads the shared Google Calendar via the Functions runtime service account (Application Default Credentials) + googleapis, imports Busy events as private booking_time_slots blocks, fails loud naming the SA email if the calendar is not shared, and the admin Scheduling "Run Sync" button is wired to it on all three platforms (web Wasm, desktop JVM, android), un-gating FF_SCHEDULING_SYNC.
summary: A new admin-only callable `syncGoogleCalendarBusyEvents` runs server-side: it authenticates with Application Default Credentials (the Functions runtime SA, no key shipped in any app), reads the shared calendar named by a `GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ID` config param via the googleapis Calendar `freebusy.query`, and upserts each busy interval into `booking_time_slots` as a private BLOCKED slot (hideDetailsFromKinfolk=true, source=GOOGLE_BUSY_IMPORT, dedup by externalEventId), writing an audit entry. On a 403/404 (calendar not shared with the SA) it throws a failed-precondition HttpsError naming auntieos-admin-calendar-sync@auntieos-ttpc.iam.gserviceaccount.com so the operator knows exactly which account to share with. The admin "Run Sync" button calls this callable on web (platformInvokeCallable), desktop (JvmFirestoreRest.callable), and android (functions.getHttpsCallable), replacing the existing client-side android GoogleCalendarService path, and FF_SCHEDULING_SYNC flips on so the web SchedulingPanel shows a real Run Sync action instead of the dark placeholder rows.

backend.plan: CREATE functions/src/admin/syncGoogleCalendarBusyEvents.ts following the listFormSchemas.ts + mapboxSearch.ts patterns. (1) ADD dependency: `npm i googleapis` in MyTribe/functions (NOT currently in package.json deps; confirmed absent). (2) Config: source the calendar id via `const GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ID = defineSecret('GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ID')` (matches mapboxSearch.ts:13 defineSecret pattern; this is functions config, NOT an app secret; operator sets it once with `firebase functions:secrets:set GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ID`). Do NOT ship any private key; use Application Default Credentials. (3) Handler `syncGoogleCalendarBusyEventsHandler(req)`: initSentry(); zod-validate args `{ lookAheadDays?: number }` (default 30, clamp 1..90); auth enforced by wrapAdminCallable. Read calId = GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ID.value(); if empty throw HttpsError('failed-precondition','calendar_id_not_configured'). Build auth via googleapis: `const auth = new google.auth.GoogleAuth({ scopes:['https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar.readonly'] })` then `const calendar = google.calendar({version:'v3', auth})` — GoogleAuth resolves the Functions runtime service account through ADC (no key file). (4) Call `calendar.freebusy.query({ requestBody:{ timeMin:nowIso, timeMax:nowPlusDaysIso, items:[{id:calId}] } })`. Wrap in try/catch: on err.code===403 OR 404 (or response status) throw HttpsError('permission-denied', `calendar_not_shared: share calendar ${calId} with auntieos-admin-calendar-sync@auntieos-ttpc.iam.gserviceaccount.com (grant See all event details)`) — this is the fail-loud SA-naming requirement. (5) For each busy interval in resp.data.calendars[calId].busy: compute externalEventId = `busy_${calId}_${startMs}_${endMs}`, date=YYYY-MM-DD, startTime/endTime=HH:mm; run a Firestore tx/query db().collection('booking_time_slots').where('externalEventId','==',id).limit(1) to dedup; set/merge a doc with the EXACT schema the android+web clients read (ServiceModels.kt:128-144): {date,startTime,endTime,isAvailable:false,slotType:'BLOCKED',notes:'Imported busy event',source:'GOOGLE_BUSY_IMPORT',externalEventId,externalCalendarId:calId,hideDetailsFromKinfolk:true,isEditableByAdmin:true,isRemovableByAdmin:true,syncState:'SYNCED',createdAt:nowIso}. Count imported/updated. (6) writeAuditEntry({event:'INTEGRATION_CALENDAR_SYNC', severity:'info', actorRole:'auntie', actorUid:req.auth.uid, targetCollection:'booking_time_slots', description:`Imported N Google busy blocks`, payload:{count,lookAheadDays,calendarId:calId}}) — add INTEGRATION_CALENDAR_SYNC to functions/src/lib/auditEvents.ts AuditEvent union. enqueueNotification is NOT required (no kinfolk-facing event; admin-initiated). Return {imported:number, scanned:number}. (7) EXPORT `export { syncGoogleCalendarBusyEvents } from './admin/syncGoogleCalendarBusyEvents'` in functions/src/index.ts (admin block near rescheduleBooking export ~line 79). onCall opts: region 'us-central1', cors same trio as listFormSchemas.ts:88-92, secrets:[GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ID,'SENTRY_DSN'], wrapAdminCallable('syncGoogleCalendarBusyEvents', handler). NOTE: the SA used for ADC is the Functions runtime SA; the operator must (a) set GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ID secret and (b) share the calendar with that runtime SA (the error names auntieos-admin-calendar-sync@... per the slice spec; if the runtime SA differs, the error string is the operator-facing source of truth and should be GOOGLE_CALENDAR_SETUP.md-documented).

errorHandling: Fail-loud everywhere, no silent degradation. SERVER: missing GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ID -> HttpsError('failed-precondition','calendar_id_not_configured'); 403/404 from freebusy.query -> HttpsError('permission-denied') whose message NAMES auntieos-admin-calendar-sync@auntieos-ttpc.iam.gserviceaccount.com and the share instruction; any other googleapis error -> rethrow as HttpsError('unavailable', `gcal_${status}`) with logEvent(severity:'warn'); non-admin caller -> wrapAdminCallable throws permission-denied. WEB/DESKTOP: WriteResult.Err -> AuntieBanner(tone=Error) rendering the raw server message (so the SA-naming string is shown verbatim to the operator), Run Sync button disabled + AuntieSpinner during the call, success shows 'Imported N busy blocks'; no fabricated 'Connected'/'Last sync' status (per spec item 9 / Rule 1). ANDROID: server message routed into SchedulingState.errorMessage and surfaced via the existing error UI (clearError available), AuntieSpinner during isLoading. The flag stays OFF (dark placeholder + Not-wired banner) until the callable is deployed AND GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ID is set AND the calendar is shared — flipping FF_SCHEDULING_SYNC via setFeatureFlags is the explicit go-live switch, so a half-configured backend never silently no-ops behind an enabled button.

risks: 1) The SA email named in the fail-loud error (auntieos-admin-calendar-sync@auntieos-ttpc.iam.gserviceaccount.com, per the slice) must be the SAME identity ADC resolves at runtime. Functions default ADC is the App Engine/compute runtime SA (PROJECT@appspot.gserviceaccount.com), NOT necessarily the named one. To make the error string accurate, set the function's runtime serviceAccount to auntieos-admin-calendar-sync@... in the onCall options (or via gcloud), and share the calendar with exactly that account. If left as the default runtime SA, change the error string to that SA instead — the string is the operator's source of truth and must match reality (Never-assume-infrastructure rule). 2) `npm i googleapis` adds a large dep and may bump the functions cold-start / bundle; acceptable for an admin-initiated callable. 3) booking_time_slots written by the Admin SDK bypass Firestore rules — fine for server writes, but confirm kinfolk-facing reads honor hideDetailsFromKinfolk=true (existing client behavior already does). 4) GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ID as a secret vs plain config: it is not sensitive, but using defineSecret matches the mapboxSearch pattern and keeps it out of source; defineString/param is equally valid. 5) Android removal of the assets key + BuildConfig sync reads must not break the build elsewhere — grep BuildConfig.GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ID / GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL usages before deleting (only the sync path should reference them).
